text: I have been contacted by a local residents of Sammon Avenue who have been having ongoing issues with access to permit parking on their street. This section of Sammon Avenue, between Coxwell and Durant is also used for student pick-up and drop-off at the adjacent elementary school and is often used for short term parking for visitors to Michael Garron Hospital too. Transportation Services has provided language to change the regulations on this block of Sammon Avenue to allow for a few additional permit parking spaces for residents. I look forward to your support for these recommendations.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Amended the existing parking prohibition in effect from 9:00 a.m. to 11:00 a.m., 1:30 p.m. to 3:00 p.m., 4:00 p.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday., except public holidays, on the north side of Sammon Avenue, between Durant Avenue and Coxwell Avenue, to be in effect from 9:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m. and 4:00 p.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday., except public holidays, between a point 46 metres west of Coxwell Avenue and a point 63 metres further west. 2.
